title: BHOC at COP17 Yerevan 2026 | Animal Health & Biodiversity
description: Meet BHOC at the UN Biodiversity Conference COP17 in Yerevan, 19-30 October 2026. Explore cooperation in animal health and species protection.

heading: BHOC at COP17: Animal Health and Biodiversity
lead: Archil Jaliashvili has received COP17 accreditation and will attend the UN Biodiversity Conference in Yerevan, Armenia, taking place from 19 to 30 October 2026.

sections.heading: What is CBD COP17?
paragraphs: COP17 is the seventeenth meeting of the Conference of the Parties to the Convention on Biological Diversity. It brings together government delegations, international organizations, scientists, conservation groups, Indigenous Peoples and businesses.

Armenia expects 10,000 to 15,000 participants, including representatives of the Convention's 196 Parties. With intergovernmental negotiations and ministerial discussions, COP17 will conduct the first global review of progress toward the biodiversity targets for 2030.

sections.heading: About Bridge That Gap Hope for Africa Initiative
paragraphs: Bridge That Gap Hope for Africa Initiative is a Nigerian nonprofit founded in 2016. It connects community action with environmental policy through biodiversity conservation, climate adaptation, education and the empowerment of women and vulnerable communities.

thanks: We warmly thank Bridge That Gap Hope for Africa Initiative and personally its Executive Director, Gloria Bulus, for their cooperation.
meetingText: Will you be in Yerevan? We would be glad to meet researchers, veterinary teams and conservation organizations to explore practical cooperation in animal health and species protection.
